notes: Call wall / put wall = strike above / below spot with the largest call / put dollar gamma, across every expiration; *_2 is the runner-up strike, often nearly tied (compare the *_gex_bn values). Gamma flip = SteelyGamma's estimate of the spot where net dealer gamma (long calls, short puts) crosses zero; other providers' flips differ. Open interest is from the prior session (oi_new = false means it had not yet updated at run time). stage premarket (about 08:30 ET) is replaced by stage open (about 09:50 ET), anchored at 09:35. nq.* are the NDX and QQQ levels mapped to the anchor's NQ contract. Not trading advice.
